_comment: Smoke test plan for aldenmere — 8 assertions covering all 8 starter classes. Hand-authored 2026-05-22 as Phase A acceptance gate proof. Generated automatically via yume-visual-tester skill in Phase B (ADR 0057).

tests._doc: Oak trees should be taller than the player. Catches scale_init mismatch on tree defs.
Mud huts should be bigger than the player (single-story shelter, ~3m tall, vs ~1.8m human).
Mud hut base should rest on ground, not sink into it. Empirical case 2026-05-18 — Tripo3D outputs needed y_offset adjustment.
Player feet on ground. Empirical case 2026-05-18 — animated morwen floated 0.85m due to stale y_offset from static-era mesh.
Player and Morwen should be visually distinguishable — soul layer 2 (visual identity) requirement for Fellowship aesthetic.
Wide NE-corner shot. Catches mystery cubes — empirical case 2026-05-21, free_camera defs without visual.hidden rendered as cubes.
Mirror sweep from SW. Two corners cover the full level.
Animated rigged player (Tripo3D animation pipeline ADR 0053) must have foot pivot — feet flush with ground.
